human_request: 重新开始下一轮，这一轮完成后你必须告诉我：有TVLSi的档次，还是没有。
purpose: Final evidence-based TVLSI submission-competitiveness verdict; no automatic R24.
claim: State-conditioned numeric relations plus real LUT6_2 support/function completion improve physical resource/quality tradeoffs beyond the registered strong approximate baselines; assess whether the independent contribution is sufficient for TVLSI.
carryover: Finish all already registered R22 physical endpoints without duplicates, then analyze them. Do not count carried-over runs as fresh R23 experiments.
sources: Frozen completed R21 three widths and four methods. No new mechanism, thresholds, compensation, masks or tuning in R23.

system.input: Signed samples and coefficients at the specified width. Standard sign-magnitude wrapper invokes unchanged unsigned MAC with addend zero. Same three-stage core latency and full FIR control/history/coefficients/accumulator for all methods.

power: All endpoints: routed functional-netlist SAIF from the same six fixed signal/filter workloads, annotated into routed checkpoints. Report dynamic/total estimated power and annotation coverage. This is not board measurement or glitch-accurate timing simulation. Timing reports and achieved common clock are reported; derived timing estimates are not a measured Fmax.
correctness: Full unsigned multiplication slice tables, independent scalar spot checks, exact signed composition oracle, RTL simulation for every workload and routed-functional replay for each endpoint. WCE bound 16*operator budget; no overflow in signed40 accumulator.
analysis: Finish complete fixed matrix before comparative selection. Retain all quality regressions, neutral/worse area, failed clocks, and tool unavailability. No post hoc filter/width selection or retuning.

labels: 有 TVLSI 投稿竞争力

yes_requires: A concrete independently useful contribution distinguished from the closest published methods, beyond assembling known solvers or count-only completeness.
Reproducible, fairly constrained physical and representative system evidence supporting the stated resource/quality claim, with costs and adverse cases retained.
Independent correctness and internally consistent frozen evidence sufficient to recommend a TVLSI submission.
decision.policy: Qualitative scientific judgment against recent real papers, not an official numerical journal threshold or acceptance guarantee. If any indispensable contribution/evidence condition remains unmet, final verdict is NO with exact reason; do not defer to another round.

stop: Analyze and deliver binary verdict after this round. No further autonomous round, manuscript, schedule, delegation or other project.
